Python-free scientific observation frames for native functional models

etr_native_scientific_source_frames.Rd

Source-aligned, read-only data-frame extracts of explicit R-list records for generalized function-on-scalar regression, sparse FPCA, and sparse multivariate FPCA. These functions do not refit, predict, or calibrate any estimator.

Usage

etr_generalized_function_on_scalar_prediction_frame(result)
etr_generalized_function_on_scalar_mean_difference_frame(result)
etr_generalized_function_on_scalar_coefficient_frame(result)
etr_generalized_function_on_scalar_exposure_frame(result)
etr_sparse_fpca_score_frame(result)
etr_sparse_mfpca_score_frame(result)

Arguments

result

An explicitly declared native R scientific record, with matching observation dimensions, finite arrays, and required model metadata. Sparse score frames preserve missing scores for retained failed fits. Band records must supply a nested prediction or reference.

Value

A source-column-ordered native data.frame; an exposure frame also carries an exposure_audit attribute describing fixed observed exposure.

Details

Observed-grid output uses the published Python 1.2.0 ordering of groups then time points. Reported bands are existing intervals only: these adapters never calculate inferential intervals. The native R-list and data-frame acceptance domain is deliberately narrower than Python typed dataclasses and pandas/NumPy coercion. It must not be presented as a fully certified one-to-one source contract. The six published Python counterparts are tracked in the source-contract gap register, with opt-in exact-source schema/value comparisons.
